notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.108

The top of the page stays on screen when you scroll:
It covers the link to the list and the breadcrumbs, the page title, the Favourites bar, and the round buttons at the top right (Sync, notifications, Back, Home, +).
On Settings, the search box stays just below it.
On a small screen, it doesn’t stay fixed if it would take up more than about 40% of the screen.
Invoices open when you click them:
This works on the customer’s page, in Invoices, and in the customer’s Transactions.
You see the invoice as QuickBooks has it: the items, and the payments and credits on it. Any payment recorded in the app links to its page.
It also lists the customer payments recorded in the app for that invoice.
Transactions open when you click them:
A payment opens its page; you can click the row or the number.
A transaction entered only in QuickBooks shows what the customer’s statement has on it.
Links inside a list row: a link or button in a row now only does its own action; it no longer opens the row as well.
Fix for Read from QuickBooks: payments that are still in QuickBooks are no longer marked as possibly deleted.
What’s new: the beta.107 entry now has its own heading. It was missing, so beta.107’s notes appeared under beta.106.
